# matia_integration_schedule (Resource)

Sync schedule for a Matia integration (PATCH /v1/integrations/:id).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "matia_integration_schedule" "example" {
  integration_id        = var.integration_id
  replication_frequency = "manual"
}

variable "integration_id" {
  type = string
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `integration_id` (String) Matia integration ID.
- `replication_frequency` (String) Sync schedule: manual, hourly, daily, cron, or a Matia API value (e.g. 60, 1440, cron).

### Optional

- `base_time` (String) Base time for scheduled syncs.
- `cron_expression` (String) Cron expression when replication_frequency is cron.
